description:
The gap matrix (_project/_archive/publishing-gap-matrix.md) recommends PRUNE for the
original prototype publishing module. The new BundlePublisher + PublicationStore is now
the supported implementation (merged via PR #13/#50, 143 tests passing).

The prototype has:
- Zero runtime consumers outside its own tests
- In-memory-only state (doesn't survive process exit)
- Non-canonical JSON serialization (duplicates the exporter)
- Fake permalink generation with no resolver service
- Declared-but-unimplemented features (secondary_storage, notifications, PARQUET)

Legacy files to remove:
- benchbox/core/publishing/publisher.py (460 lines)
- benchbox/core/publishing/artifacts.py (340 lines)
- benchbox/core/publishing/permalink.py (~200 lines)
- benchbox/core/publishing/config.py (~200 lines)

Legacy test files to remove:
- tests/unit/core/publishing/test_publisher.py
- tests/unit/core/publishing/test_artifacts.py
- tests/unit/core/publishing/test_permalink.py
- tests/unit/core/publishing/test_publishing_config.py

Legacy __init__.py exports to remove: 12 symbols (PublishFormat, PublishingConfig,
RetentionPolicy, StorageConfig, StorageProvider, Artifact, ArtifactManager,
ArtifactMetadata, ArtifactStatus, ArtifactType, Permalink, PermalinkGenerator,
PermalinkRegistry, PublishBatchResult, Publisher, PublishResult)

anti_patterns.dont: remove files piecemeal without verifying zero consumers first
anti_patterns.instead: scan the full tree before deleting

preserves.behavior: BundlePublisher, PublicationStore, BundlePublishResult, PublicationRecord, build_reference must remain
benchbox publish CLI command group must remain functional
benchbox run --publish integration must remain functional
test_publish_store.py and test_publish_cli.py must remain and pass

verifications.command: uv run ruff check benchbox/core/publishing/ && ! grep -r 'ArtifactManager\|PermalinkRegistry\|PermalinkGenerator' benchbox/ --include='*.py' | grep -v '__pycache__'
uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/core/publishing/ tests/integration/test_publish_cli.py -q
verifications.expected: All tests pass (count will drop by ~80 from removing legacy tests)

work_units.notes:
grep for imports of Publisher, ArtifactManager, PermalinkGenerator, etc.
Confirm the only consumers are __init__.py re-exports and test files.
work_units.summary: Verify zero runtime imports of legacy symbols outside tests and __init__.py
Remove legacy source files (publisher.py, artifacts.py, permalink.py, config.py)
Remove legacy test files (test_publisher.py, test_artifacts.py, test_permalink.py, test_publishing_config.py)
Clean up __init__.py: remove legacy imports and __all__ entries
Run full test suite to verify no regressions
